Migena Ndreu
a month ago
Luigi and his crew did an amazing job renovating our entire home. He finished everything in six weeks, which was faster than we expected. The crew kept everything clean and Luigi was always in time and explained everything to us. Our home looks completely different now. We highly recommend Luigi Building & Remodeling.
Valentina Cook
a month ago
They did quite a number of repairs throughout our house, including refinishing a bathroom. They were prompt, polite, and did excellent work. Luigi is very responsive and accommodating. I would hire them again.
Jeff Liang
3 months ago
We hired Luigj and his team to renovate our basement, bathroom, and major repairs needed. Their team was extremely professional and completed all work with great care and quality. Everything we've asked for was delivered to our satisfaction. They are trustworthy, honest, transparent, and fair with pricing. I would highly recommend Luigj and his team for all projects.
Egesta Zhupi
3 months ago
We chose Luigi Building & Remodeling for our home addition, and it was one of the best decisions we made. The team was knowledgeable, honest, and incredibly skilled. They delivered high-quality work while staying within budget and completing the project on time. We are thrilled with the final result and highly recommend them.
Etleva Mollosmani
3 months ago
Luigi Building & Remodeling transformed our outdated kitchen into a beautiful, modern space. They listened to our ideas, offered helpful suggestions, and delivered exceptional craftsmanship. The crew was respectful, clean, and always on schedule. We couldn't be happier with the results!
Sibora Terziu
3 months ago
We had an excellent experience with Luigi Building & Remodeling. From the initial consultation to the final walkthrough, everything was handled professionally. The team was reliable, communicated clearly, and paid close attention to every detail. The quality of the workmanship exceeded our expectations, and the project was completed on time. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a trustworthy remodeling contractor.
Philip Abraham
3 months ago
It was great to work with Luigi getting our home ready to sell. He made great suggestions and drew up detailed plans. We remodeled two bathrooms, retiled the kitchen, painted, etc. .Executed everything on a tight schedule on time. Last minute hiccups were dealt with seamlessly and promptly. Very stress free. Highly recommended.
Mf Buildings
5 months ago
John Messina
8 months ago
Luigi Building & Remodeling did a super job on our home renovation.  Their professionalism, patience, and flexibility helped us remodel within our budget and expectations!  Thank you LB&R and we look forward to working together in the near future!
Tobias Waring
8 months ago
5/5 Stars – Highly Recommend Luigi!

We had a fantastic experience working with Luigi as our general contractor for a renovation on our 1923 home in Rye. He came in right within our budget and stuck to the estimated timeline, which is impressive for any renovation, especially with an older property. Despite interviewing five other contractors, we’re so glad we chose Luigi and his team. His communication was excellent—he was always pleasant, responsive, and easy to reach by phone or in person.

Older houses always come with a few surprises, and sure enough, some small unforeseen issues came up during the project. Luigi handled every one quickly, professionally, and with zero drama—keeping everything on track without any stress.

We now trust him completely and can’t recommend him enough. If you’re looking for a reliable, skilled, and genuinely nice contractor who stays true to his word on budget and schedule, Luigi is the one to call!

Thank you, Luigi—we’re thrilled with the results!
lendrit januzaj
8 months ago
Luigi is absolutely my go-to GC. He’s incredibly professional, and his team reflects the same values and work ethic. They delivered amazing results even with a very tight renovation schedule. I’ll always be thankful to Luigi for his help and dedication.
Margaret Donohue
9 months ago
Luigj and his team did a bathroom renovation and it was great! The team was polite, friendly and respectful of me and my home. All were qualified workers and the job was completed so quickly! Luigj oversaw all aspects of the job and frequently conferred with me. Without hesitation I would recommend this company.
Anthony Pugliese
a year ago
Luigi and his team were courteous, professional and skillful. Dealing with Luigi was a pleasure- right from the start. He provided us with a detailed estimate and it was thorough. Luigi explained everything each step of the way and we could not be happier with our new kitchen. They worked magic installing our new porcelain floor! We highly recommend Luigi Building and Home Remodeling and look forward to working with him on future projects!
Kevin Lee
a year ago
Luigi and his team helped with some small-medium renovations on my house, and I couldn’t be more happy with the results. From start to finish, they were professional, reliable, and attentive to detail. Communication was easy and clear throughout the process, and they made sure everything was completed on time and within budget. The quality of their work exceeded my expectations, and they treated my home with care and respect. I would highly recommend Luigi and his team to anyone looking for a trustworthy, honest, and skilled contractor.
Aaron Marcus
a year ago
Luigi completed a whole house renovation for us -- the house was taken down to the studs. Luigi and his team did an excellent job and I'd highly recommend them. The quality of the work was excellent, coupled with excellent communication. He was always available to meet or speak on the phone and answer any questions or discuss details with the project. Luigi provided feedback on design along the way that allowed us to save money or make changes in real time to adjust to onsite conditions. It is hard to find trustworthy and reliable contractors that do excellent work, and Luigi does just that.
Abigail Damoulakis
a year ago
We worked with Luigi and his team on a few big projects in our home. We felt very comfortable throughout the renovation process as Luigi is very responsive and thoughtful when making recommendations. In the face of some unexpected challenges, Luigi and his team responded quickly and skillfully. We completely trust Luigi and fully recommend him for any size project.
Dalina Marku
2 years ago
I highly recommend Luigi to do any work whether that being building or remodeling, indoors or outdoors. Luigi is very professional and a good listener. He is there to fulfill his clients wishes and ecxpectations.

ABOUT US

Luigi Building & Remodeling LLC is a licensed and insured general contracting company based in Mamaroneck, New York. Our mission is to deliver high quality construction services while maintaining transparency, reliability, and superior workmanship.

We collaborate with architects, engineers, and designers to execute projects
ranging from structural renovations to complete residential transformations.
Our experience managing multi-phase construction projects allows us to maintain
strict timelines, budgets, and quality standards.

Our reputation is built on professionalism, attention to detail, and the
ability to successfully deliver projects that increase both property value and
functionality.

SERVICE AREAS
We proudly provide construction services throughout Westchester County, including:
Mamaroneck
Larchmont
Rye
Harrison
New Rochelle
Scarsdale
White Plains

We want to be your Go-To Neighborhood Remodeler for life! We live and work in the same communities we serve. At Design Pro we care beyond the build. We show up when we say we will and deliver 5-Star craftsmanship.

Earning your trust is our highest priority. We are guided by our leading core value – Do the Right Thing, Period.
